description: This file defines the `PumpStream` class in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library, which provides a read-only stream that pumps data from a PHP callable source. It implements the `StreamInterface` and manages internal buffering, stream control operations, and data pumping via the source callable.

classes.name: PumpStream
classes.description: Provides a read-only stream that pumps data from a PHP callable, implementing methods for stream control, data reading, and metadata management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a PumpStream with a data source callable and optional stream options including size and metadata.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream contents as a string, handling exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream by detaching internal references.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the stream's internal source and resets position.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached EOF (end of file).

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream does not support seeking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws exception as seeking is unsupported.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream is not writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws exception as writing is unsupported.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream supports reading.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer, pumping more data from the source if needed.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the entire remaining content of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns stream metadata or specific metadata key value.

methods.name: pump
methods.description: Private method to invoke the source callable and fill the internal buffer with data.
